newsitem.title: USA: St Joe offers $428.4 million for Florida East.
newsitem.headline: St Joe offers $428.4 million for Florida East.

text.p: St. Joe Corp. said Monday it has proposed to acquire the remaining stake in Florida East Coast Industries, a real estate development and railroad company, that it does not own for $428.4 million.

St. Joe, Florida's largest private landowner, said it is offering $102 per share. St. Joe already owns about 4.9 million, or 54 percent, of the 9.1 million Florida East Coast common shares outstanding.
Jacksonville-based Florida East Coast's stock closed Friday at $88.75 on the New York Stock Exchange. St. Joe rose $2.75 to $76 early Monday on the NYSE.
The deal would be subject to the negotiation of a merger agreement and approval by regulators and Florida East Coast shareholders.
St. Joe, based in Jacksonville, Fla., has interests in real estate, timber, railroads and sugar.
